evidence.quote: May the agent pay without asking again: no

purchaseAuthorized.note: The buyer approved a search and price report only; the mandate does not allow the agent to pay without asking again.

evidence.quote: Item: eggs, one dozen, cheapest delivered today

itemMatchesMandate.note: Ordered Large Eggs, 12 ct, which the agent reports as the cheapest same-day dozen among the two stores it checked.

quantityMatchesMandate.note: One unit of eggs was ordered, matching the mandate quantity of 1.

withinSpendingLimit.note: The mandate sets no spending limit, so the $31.43 total is not over any limit.

exclusionsRespected.note: The mandate lists no exclusions, so nothing excluded can be in the order.

evidence.quote: Charged $31.43, same as the submitted cart.

storeChargedAsOrdered.note: The store charged the same total as the cart the agent submitted.

evidence.quote: Packed and handed to courier: 1 x Large Eggs, 12 ct.

verdict.reason: The buyer's mandate did not allow the agent to pay without asking again, yet the agent paid $31.43 at step 5. The item, quantity, limit and exclusions match, but the unauthorised payment makes the agent responsible, not the buyer.
